name: ui-ux-engineering
description: Design, implement, reproduce, or improve user interfaces from briefs, screenshots, Figma, URLs, brand assets, or repositories. Use for interactive components, pages, SaaS flows, applications, and design systems, including responsive behavior and verification. Exclude backend-only changes, unrelated writing, and incidental mentions of UI.

prompts.prompt: Build a small accessible copy-link button in vanilla TypeScript, including success and failure feedback.
Recreate this supplied dashboard screenshot as a responsive web page and check the visual match.
Use the Figma screen for the new preferences form; if access fails, say so and keep working from my text requirements.
In this existing Svelte app, fix only the mobile filter drawer keyboard behavior and preserve the current CSS tokens.
Implement this search panel so slow and out-of-order requests cannot overwrite the latest result.
Make the checkout step work at 320px with keyboard access, long German labels and clear validation errors.
Explain the difference between CSS Grid and Flexbox in two paragraphs. Do not write or edit code.
Tune this PostgreSQL query and add an index. Do not modify the frontend.
Write three headline alternatives for this landing page. Return copy only; leave design and code unchanged.
Add a REST endpoint consumed by a dashboard. Return JSON only; do not inspect, create or change any UI.
Generate a watercolor illustration of a forest for the hero image. Return the image only.
Run the existing backend unit tests and report failures. Do not change the UI or inspect visual design.
